newsitem.title: UK: INSIGHT - Bunds form head-and-shoulders, eye 101.61.
newsitem.headline: INSIGHT - Bunds form head-and-shoulders, eye 101.61.

text.p: Bunds have formed a potentially bullish reverse head-and-shoulders pattern on the daily charts, technical analysts said on Wednesday.
"It will have a go at the 101.10/20 area and once through there the March 17 high is the next target," said Anne Whitby, head of technical analysis at 4CAST in London. "It could do that today."
The March 17 high was 101.61, before the market dropped to a low of 100.15.
June Bund futures traded on LIFFE were up 0.06 at 100.93 by 0705 GMT.
Whitby said once above the 101.61 level there was more supply which could put the brakes on the market.
A technical analyst at a European bank in London said his initial goal was 101.12/13, but "over time the base formed can support a run to the 102.00 area."
He said such a rally was unlikely to take place in one go, and a pullback of about half a point was to be expected. Such a correction, he said, would be a good opportunity to buy into the market.
On the downside, support was pegged at 100.64/66, which was the top of a basing pattern, and also the April 9 high.
Below there, Whitby said 100.34 was the next line of defence, representing congestion over the last week.
She said the technical picture for Bunds had been anticipating a rally, and the move up was in part sparked by U.S. T-bonds finding very solid support.
June Euromarks look constructive on the charts, analysts said, with scope for a push to the low 96.80s. They were trading up one basis point at 96.76.
